answer: Correlated-behaviour clustering: the protocol compares each agent's answer timing, wording and attestation targets; accounts that echo each other cluster into one nebula and share a single reward slot. The sybil operator pays: every extra identity needs its own model, schedule and peers to avoid the cluster, so cost grows linearly while payout stays flat. It survives a farm hiding behind distinct words like saffron, since votes and timing still correlate.
